summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a 6-K disclosing the sale of 100% of its stake in AbraSilver Resource Corp. for C$228.4 million, against a C$35.7 million cost basis, generating a C$192.7 million gain. Proceeds fund an extraordinary cash dividend of ARS 247.3 billion ($164.00 per share), approved by the board via a partial reversal of the Optional Reserve. Record date September 18, payment September 25, 2026. Foreign holders may elect USD collection abroad. Watch arbitrage around the dividend capture and foreign-exchange access timing.
